diseaseRisk.advisoryHighRisk: High fungal blight risk due to combined high humidity (>80%) and cool-to-warm temperatures. Inspect lower foliage daily and consult your extension officer.
diseaseRisk.advisoryModerateRisk: Moderate foliar risk: maintain adequate plant spacing, weed control, and monitor canopy.
diseaseRisk.advisoryLowRisk: Low weather-induced disease pressure. Continue regular preventive monitoring.

sprayWindow.guidelines: Do not spray when foliage is wet with morning dew. Avoid spraying during peak sunshine (>35°C) to prevent phytotoxic leaf scorch.

diseaseRisk.advisoryHighRisk: Critical late blight weather window: persistent relative humidity >85% and cool temperatures (15-23°C). Immediate field inspection recommended.
diseaseRisk.advisoryModerateRisk: Moderate risk: monitor field borders and shaded canopy spots.
diseaseRisk.advisoryLowRisk: Favorable dry conditions. Disease development inhibited by sunshine.

sprayWindow.guidelines: Spray early morning after dew dries. Ensure complete underside coverage of canopy.

diseaseRisk.advisoryHighRisk: Warm wet weather creates high risk for bacterial spot spread via rain splashes. Inspect foliage and consult extension officer.
diseaseRisk.advisoryModerateRisk: Moderate risk: avoid sprinkler irrigation to prevent leaf wetness duration.
diseaseRisk.advisoryLowRisk: Dry conditions reduce bacterial and fungal leaf spot multiplication.

sprayWindow.guidelines: Avoid spraying during active bee foraging hours.

diseaseRisk.advisoryHighRisk: High blast / sheath blight weather index: night temperature below 24°C with relative humidity >85% and persistent dew. Inspect tillers immediately.
diseaseRisk.advisoryModerateRisk: Moderate disease pressure. Drain excess standing water if sheath blight is suspected.
diseaseRisk.advisoryLowRisk: Weather conditions unfavorable for rapid fungal spore germination.

sprayWindow.guidelines: Maintain water level at 2-3 cm during spraying. Target the lower leaf sheaths for sheath blight.

diseaseRisk.advisoryHighRisk: High foliar blight risk due to continuous leaf wetness and moderate temperatures. Inspect lower and middle leaves.
diseaseRisk.advisoryModerateRisk: Moderate foliar risk. Monitor upper ear leaves.

sprayWindow.guidelines: Direct spray towards upper whorl and ear leaves.
